lines.text: In which country are the Southern Alps?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: It's New Zealand: about five hundred kilometres down the South Island.
Highest: Aoraki, Mount Cook, three thousand seven hundred and twenty-four metres.
The Tasman Glacier, its longest, runs twenty-three kilometres.
It all rides the Alpine Fault, where the Pacific and Australian plates collide.
Tomorrow, the country with the most time zones. Subscribe, and guess it first.

title: In which country are the SOUTHERN ALPS?
